title: ROS 2 node shutdown: Ctrl+C, SIGTERM, "rcl_shutdown already called" and launch's 5-second escalation (measured on Humble, Jazzy, Lyrical)
excerpt: Catch KeyboardInterrupt and ExternalShutdownException, clean up in finally, end with rclpy.try_shutdown(). Measured: rclpy.shutdown() errors on Humble/Jazzy, SIGTERM raises RCLError on Lyrical, with rclpy.init() only works on Lyrical, and sigterm_timeout stops launch from killing slow cleanup.
